wu: Warm-up: 'Recycle Relay' — children line up in teams, race to a bin with mixed paper/plastic items, shout the English name (e.g., 'bottle!', 'box!'), and run back. Teacher times each team for 60 seconds.
wuAlt: Alternative 1: 'Recycle Pictionary' — draw a recyclable item, teammates guess the English word.
Alternative 2: 'Recycle Bingo' — teacher calls items, children cross them off their bingo cards.
pres: Presentation: Show flashcards of recyclable items (paper, plastic, glass) and non-recyclable (food, plastic bags). Model sentences: 'This is paper. We can recycle paper.' Ask: 'Can we recycle this?' Children respond 'Yes, we can' or 'No, we can't'.
presAlt: Alternative 1: Use a short story about a character sorting trash into bins.
Alternative 2: Bring real recyclable items (e.g., bottles, cans) for children to touch and name.
prac: Guided practice: 'Recycle Sort Game' — children work in teams to sort picture cards into 'recycle' or 'don't recycle' bins. Teacher monitors and corrects pronunciation. Teams earn points for correct sorts.
pracAlt: Alternative 1: 'Recycle Memory' — match pairs of recyclable items with their English names.
Alternative 2: 'Recycle Charades' — act out recycling actions, teammates guess the verb (e.g., 'cut', 'fold').
ls: Listening slot: 'Earth Day Quiz' — children listen to teacher ask questions about recycling (e.g., 'What can we recycle?'). They raise hands to answer. Teacher checks comprehension by asking follow-ups: 'Why can't we recycle plastic bags?'
re: Reactivation game: 'Recycle Tag' — children run around the room. Teacher shouts a recyclable item; tagged children freeze and say its English name. Last child unfreezes them.
prod: Production task: 'Plant-a-Seed Craft' — children follow 'First... then...' instructions to plant seeds in cups (e.g., 'First, put soil in the cup. Then, put a seed in the soil. Next, add water.'). They present their cups to the class using the target language.
rw: Reading and writing slot: 'Recycling Poster' — children read a short paragraph about Earth Day (e.g., 'We can help Earth. Recycle paper, plastic, and glass.'). Then, they write 2 sentences about what they recycle at home (e.g., 'I recycle bottles. I recycle boxes.').
st: Story/Song + Goodbye: Sing 'Reduce, Reuse, Recycle' song with actions. End with 'Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line'.
g: Teams take turns answering review questions for points.
Race to sort items into bins and name them.
Follow 'First... then...' instructions to plant seeds.
Draw recyclable items for teammates to guess.
Cross off items called by the teacher.
diff: Fast finishers: Design a 'Recycling Hero' badge with 3 English words.
Support: Use sentence starters for writing (e.g., 'I recycle...').
hw: Homework 1: Find 3 things at home to recycle and name them in English.
Homework 2: Draw a picture of you recycling and write 1 sentence.
Homework 3: Ask your family 1 recycling question in English.
tip: Use local examples (e.g., Moroccan plastic recycling bins) to make the theme relatable. Praise effort over accuracy to build confidence.
checklist: I can name 5 recyclable items in English.
I can sort items into 'recycle' and 'don't recycle'.
I can write 2 sentences about recycling.
I can answer quiz questions about Earth Day.
I can present my plant-a-seed craft to the class.
I can play a recycling game with my team.
